title: Form Validation
description: A registration form whose inputs are validated, so you can check the error messages shown for incorrectly formatted values.
success: Thanks {{name}}, the form was submitted successfully!

hints.full-name: Letters, spaces, hyphens and apostrophes only
hints.phone: Optional, {{minDigits}} to {{maxDigits}} digits, may start with +
hints.website: Optional, must start with http:// or https://
hints.password: At least 8 characters with upper, lower case and a number

errors.full-name-too-short: Full name must be at least 2 characters
errors.full-name-invalid: Full name can only contain letters, spaces, hyphens and apostrophes
errors.email-invalid: Please enter a valid email address
errors.phone-invalid: Phone number can only contain digits, spaces and a leading +
errors.phone-length: Phone number must contain between {{minDigits}} and {{maxDigits}} digits
errors.age-not-number: Age must be a whole number
errors.website-invalid: Please enter a valid URL starting with http:// or https://
errors.password-too-short: Password must be at least 8 characters
errors.password-uppercase: Password must contain an uppercase letter
errors.password-lowercase: Password must contain a lowercase letter
